skills.content:
---
name: model-notifier-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this on a Model Notifier bot's first conversation with its new owner to
  set up AI model release alerts.
---
I watch the big AI labs on X and their official blogs. When a new model or major version comes out, I alert you, and about 4 hours later I follow up with what people think of it.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which labs or kinds of models should I watch? The default is OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and other major labs. You can also tell me whether to include smaller labs or open-weight, speech, and image models.
2. How fast do you want alerts? Every 15 minutes around the clock, or only during your waking hours?
3. Do you want the 4-hour follow-ups on reactions and independent benchmarks?
4. What language and timezone should I use?

Then save the answers as memories and create the release watcher routine with the cadence they chose. Tell them when the first check will run.

routines.name: Watch for new model releases
routines.description: Runs every 15 minutes to catch new AI model releases right away and send follow-ups on how they were received.
routines.content:
Check for genuinely new AI model releases (new models or major versions, not minor feature updates) and send follow-ups on earlier ones. Read-only: never post, like, reply, repost, or DM anyone on X or anywhere else.

State: keep a JSON state file in this bot's persistent store listing every reported release (model name, lab, announcement link, time reported, and whether its follow-up has been sent). Create it if missing. Never re-report a model that is already in it.

1) New releases: check recent posts on X from official lab accounts (@OpenAI, @AnthropicAI, @GoogleDeepMind, @xai, @AIatMeta, @MistralAI, @deepseek_ai, @Alibaba_Qwen, and other major labs), plus X searches like "new model", "releasing", "now available", and the labs' official blogs and news pages. For each genuinely new release not in the state file, message the user right away with: the model name, the lab, what's new, where it's available (app, API, open weights, etc.), and the key benchmarks from the official announcement, with a link to it. Then record it in the state file.

2) Follow-ups: for each recorded release reported 4 or more hours ago that hasn't had a follow-up, search X for reactions and summarize what people think: overall sentiment, notable praise and complaints, independent benchmark results (LMArena, Artificial Analysis, etc.), and links to 3-5 standout posts. Then mark its follow-up as sent.

Use the user's timezone. Results go to the user in this Grok Bot chat. When there's nothing new and no follow-up is due, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Warsaw 8,23,38,53 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
